T:P1.4.text: Encore Capital Group® is a global specialty finance company with operations and investments across North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America. Through its subsidiaries around the globe, Encore purchases or services portfolios of receivables from major banks, credit unions and utility providers. Customer service and regulatory compliance are at the heart of our business and are implemented through our collections strategy.

T:P2.9.text: Through our subsidiaries and affiliates, we purchase portfolios of defaulted receivables from financial service providers including banks, credit unions, consumer finance companies, and commercial retailers. After purchasing defaulted debt, we partner with individuals as they repay their obligations and work toward financial recovery. We also provide debt servicing for consumer and business-to-business accounts as well as portfolio management services to credit originators for non-performing loans.

T:P2.11.text: We leverage an industry-leading consumer database, in-house statisticians, business analysts, and software programmers to continually enhance proprietary behavioral and valuation models, custom software applications, and other business tools that guide our portfolio purchases and collection strategies.

T:P2.12.text: We focus on raising and deploying capital prudently to maximize our return on invested capital. Our operational scale and geographic diversification enable us to adjust to market trends and deploy capital to maximize risk-adjusted returns.

C:P1.2.text: PRA Group delivers nonperforming loan solutions that drive success through a long-term focus and customer care.

C:P1.3.text: With its global headquarters located in Norfolk, Virginia, PRA Group, Inc. is a company that has grown to become one of the largest acquirers of nonperforming loans in the world. Its portfolio operations span multiple countries, 12 languages and 12 currencies. Through its subsidiaries, PRA Group returns essential capital to banks and other lenders, helping expand financial services available to consumers and businesses.

C:P1.4.text: PRA Group went public on, and has since grown to become one of the largest purchasers of nonperforming loans in the world.

C:P2.2.text: 30 years of redefining the nonperforming loan industry.

C:P2.3.text: Doing things the right way, for the right reasons, with a long-term focus.

C:P2.4.text: To deliver nonperforming loan solutions that drive success through a long-term focus and customer care.

C:P2.5.text: From a single employee to the global footprint of PRA Group and its subsidiaries, our company is built on this mission. It gives purpose to, and is the foundation of, everything we do.

C:P2.6.text: To be the trusted leader, changing the world’s perception of the nonperforming loan industry.

C:P2.7.text: This shared vision fuels our pursuit of redefining the nonperforming loan industry, is our guiding light to the future of PRA Group and sets our bar for success.
